issues.detail: The Hebrew text does not mention 'Đức Giê-hô-va' (the LORD/Yahweh) in this verse; the subject is 'my righteousness' (צִדְקָתִי) which will answer/testify. The Vietnamese adds 'Đức Giê-hô-va sẽ chứng' (the LORD will testify), which introduces a divine name and a concept not present in the Hebrew.
